readout_other: resting-state BOLD functional connectivity of sgACC
direction_notes: sgACC-whole-brain functional connectivity increased after active tFUS relative to sham (trend during sonication); the authors state the direction of change in neural activity cannot be inferred from BOLD connectivity.
safety_notes: Subjects did not report perceptions of tFUS after the conclusion of their two sessions.

timing.protocol_description: Five 20-s sonications with a 40-s interval between sonications, delivered at 300 s into a 15-min resting-state fMRI run; PRF 40 Hz, duty cycle 30%.

source_quotes.n_subjects: In a sham-controlled, within-subject study of healthy adults (N = 16), we measured resting-state bloodoxygen-level dependent (BOLD) activity with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) before, during, and after five minutes of tFUS (i.e., five 20-second sonications followed by 40 second pauses).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Participants. Sixteen healthy adults (7 females; age 26 ± 7 years, mean ± standard deviation) participated in a withinsubjects study consisting of two sessions employing Active and Sham tFUS.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: tFUS Parameters. tFUS was delivered at 500 kHz with a circular transducer (Sonic Concepts CTX-500) driven by an integrated function generator and amplifier (Sonic Concepts NeuroFUS; Fig 1a).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The waveform was pulsed with a repetition frequency (PRF) of 40 Hz and a duty cycle of 30%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: The waveform was pulsed with a repetition frequency (PRF) of 40 Hz and a duty cycle of 30%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Sonication duration was 20 s, with a 40 s interval between successive sonications (Fig 1e).
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.ispta_w_cm2: Acoustic intensity was measured in a water tank under free-field conditions with a calibrated hydrophone (ONDA corporation) as $I _ { \mathrm { s p t a } } = 6 6 7 \ : \mathrm { m W / c m ^ { 2 } }$ .
